invariants.name: feasible_start_suffix_monotonicity
invariants.description: For a fixed query (t,d), let idx be the last index with a[idx]≤t. The condition that all adjacent differences from i to idx-1 are ≤d is monotonic in i: if it holds for some i, it also holds for any j>i (j≤idx-1). Thus the set of feasible starts is a suffix of [1,idx-1], enabling binary search.
